assessor: Nonblind Codex AI coding assistants, implementation contributors; identities available but predicted rankings withheld until product annotations are fixed. No human validation or inter-rater reliability claim.
purpose: Complete 600-product by 120-query AI proxy relevance matrix, separate from unchanged human qrels and original benchmark.
evidence: One actual catalogue photograph and exact cached multilingual ABO listing values per product. No model predictions/scores/rankings, cloud API or GPU inference used for labels.

type_definitions.running_shoes: Visibly athletic trainer/running-shoe appearance or explicit source identification; no performance guarantee.
type_definitions.ankle_boots: Boot with shaft at/just above ankle, below mid-calf; uncertain if crop prevents shaft judgement.
type_definitions.sandals: Open construction with sandal straps/open toe or heel; not a closed dress shoe.
type_definitions.flat_shoes: Dress flats, low/no-heel loafers or ballet-style shoes; athletic trainers are not classified as dress flats.
type_definitions.casual_shoes: Everyday leisure trainers, slip-ons or informal closed lace-ups; may overlap running-shoe appearance.
type_definitions.handbags: Handheld, shoulder, crossbody or tote bag; excludes backpack and wallet.
type_definitions.wallets: Wallet/cardholder/purse for money or cards, rather than a handbag.
type_definitions.hats: Headwear including cap, beanie and brimmed hat.
type_definitions.earrings: Ear jewellery, including studs, hoops and drops.
type_definitions.necklaces: Necklace/pendant chain; exclude visually identified bracelet or anklet even in a mixed source category.
type_definitions.rings: Finger ring, including plain bands and decorative rings.

trait_scale.0: Absent or conflicting with requested visual attribute
trait_scale.1: Weak/partial match, such as an accent colour or limited style resemblance
trait_scale.2: Clear dominant/strong visual or explicit-source match
trait_scale.null: Cannot assess; retain uncertainty rather than inventing a negative

trait_definitions.black: Visible black principal areas; accent only is weak.
trait_definitions.white: Visible white/ivory principal areas; accent only is weak.
trait_definitions.red: Visible red/burgundy principal areas; orange/pink are not automatically red.
trait_definitions.neutral: Subdued black, white, grey, beige, tan, brown, navy or conventional gold/silver tones dominate.
trait_definitions.simple_everyday: Uncomplicated practical everyday styling for the product class; not a durability/function measurement.
trait_definitions.metallic_finish: Visible reflective metallic finish; metal material alone does not prove visible sheen.
trait_definitions.formal: Dressy/elegant occasion appearance appropriate to its product class; subjective appearance proxy.
trait_definitions.minimalist: Restrained clean design with limited ornamentation; plain does not imply measured quality.
trait_definitions.travel_appearance: Compact/simple or visibly portable/practical appearance for its class. Does not establish physical weight, comfort, airline acceptance or travel performance.
trait_definitions.bold_decorative: Prominent pattern, sculptural form, conspicuous embellishment or decorative motif; mere brightness alone can be weak.

qrels_rules.travel_exception: For lightweight-for-travel queries, trait2 gives2 unless an exact source citation explicitly supports lightweight, when3 is permitted. Unknown physical weight is always disclosed; ordinary traits have no grade2 by design.

metrics.metrics: AI-proxy nDCG@10, MRR@10, Hit@10, precision@10, recall@10 using only known AI-proxy relevant denominator; coverage@10 and all-catalogue-complete flag. Never call this objective/human Recall.
metrics.unknowns: Report sensitivity using all unknown grades0 and all unknown grades3; these are two scenario estimates, not necessarily tight nDCG bounds.

invariants: Do not change catalogue, queries, original human qrels, original model outputs or frozen runtime.
Annotate products independently of predicted rankings; freeze all profiles before score access.
Every product has an authored visual note, confidence, exact image hash, and explicit uncertainty.
Exact multilingual source citations retain language tags; an unknown source property stays unknown.
